captions.detailed: A handheld camcorder featuring a rectangular main body, a front-mounted cylindrical lens assembly, a hand strap on the right side, and a flip-out LCD panel on the left side. The entire body is primarily matte black, with grey accents highlighting the lens rings and a small mode dial on the top rear corner. The LCD screen swings outward on a vertical hinge, the zoom ring on the lens barrel rotates continuously, and the top-rear mode dial spins about its vertical axis.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a handheld camcorder with a rectangular main body, a cylindrical front lens assembly with a rotatable zoom ring, a right-side hand strap, and a left-side flip-out LCD panel. Ensure the LCD screen rotates on a vertical hinge, the zoom ring rotates about the optical axis, and a small mode dial on the top rear of the camera body rotates about its vertical axis.
captions.factory: Construct the main camera body using a Box primitive with filleted edges, adding a smaller rectangular block on top and a cylindrical mode dial at the rear. Model the lens assembly using concentric Cylinder primitives of varying diameters, including a textured zoom ring. Build the hand strap on the right side using thin rectangular boxes, and construct the LCD panel as a flat box on the left. Set up three revolute joint connections: one for the LCD screen hinge on a vertical axis, one for the zoom ring around the lens axis, and one for the mode dial on the top deck.
